plain: Giving up a job or an office

webster.text: The act of resigning or giving up, as a claim or possession; as the resignation of a crown or commission.

example.quote: On the death, resignation or removal of the Governour his authorities to be exercised by the President of the Senate till a Successor be appointed.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, June 18, 1787
